trials.name: Bounded sunlight loop
trials.decision: Rejected: no consistent wide-view saving; close-view completed-draw medians are worse in both ABBA positions.

trials.name: One weather lookup for subpixel ray columns
trials.decision: Rejected: close-view timing did not establish a saving; cloud radiance RMSE versus the 400-step reference more than doubled in the day view.

currentCloudReference.observedLimitation: Magnified limb crests remain in the 800-step reconstruction. More integration samples alone do not remove this field-shape artifact.

completedDrawProfile.method: One-pixel readback witnesses GPU completion. Per-stage readbacks introduce synchronization overhead; these are diagnostic draw costs, not live frame-rate measurements.

supersededTimingTrials: Per-pass GPU timers yielded non-additive stage intervals; finish-only intervals did not demonstrate draw completion. Neither is used to attribute the bottleneck.

scientificFollowup.finding: NASA MODIS retrieves cloud-top properties using infrared measurements and optical thickness using visible/near-infrared measurements.
scientificFollowup.inference: The current single brightness-to-height heuristic is not a measured height field. Investigate height and coverage reconstruction separately while retaining consistent view, sunlight and ground-shadow density.
